parameters.name: DevTag
parameters.description: The ID of the terminal device.

parameters.name: DiagnoseType
parameters.description:
The diagnosis type. Valid values:

- **FullLink**: full-link diagnosis.
- **Application**: application diagnosis.

parameters.name: PopMode
parameters.description:
The POP point selection mode. Valid values:
- **AutoSelect**: automatic selection.
- **ManualSelect**: manual selection.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The protocol used by the internal network access application. Valid values:
- **TCP**
- **UDP**.

parameters.name: UdpExtraConfigs
parameters.description: The extra configurations for UDP diagnosis. If this parameter is not specified, any response received is considered a success.
